The '''Sphere of Biotic Science''', also known as the '''Ministry of Biotic Science''' and the '''Pyramid of Biotic Science''', was one of the twelve [[Spheres of Influence]] within the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Established in [[4980 BBY]] along with the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]], the Sphere was ruled by a member of the Council throughout its history. The Sphere controlled all alchemical and biotic science within the Empire, overseeing the [[Imperial Medical Corps]] and sharing joint control of the [[Imperial Science Bureau (Sith Empire)|Imperial Science Bureau]] with the [[Sphere of Technology]]. [[Darth Acharon]] was head of the Sphere during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and in that position he oversaw the branches of the Empire that dealt in [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] augmentation and physical enhancement, often in conjunction with [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] and [[Sith sorcery/Legends|magic]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

After the Empire's defeat at the hand of the [[Eternal Empire]], the sphere was combined with the [[Sphere of Technology]] into the [[Sphere of Scientific Advancement]] by Empress [[Darth Acina]].<ref name="SOTG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sphere of Technology was introduced in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', in the section on the Spheres of Influence.
